findings.description: Substantial standard of care deviation identified in clinical management timeline.

explainedTerms.definition: Frontal and lateral thoracic X-rays required by ATS/IDSA guidelines to diagnose community-acquired pneumonia and exclude mimics.
Initial antimicrobial treatment initiated before definitive microbiological pathogen identification.
